title: Process agent RPC messages
responsibility: Match incoming replies to requests and manage request sending and timeouts.

inputs.name: rpcMessages.state
inputs.description: Pending-request map, notification listeners and sender.

inputs.name: rpcMessages.line
inputs.description: One JSON message line; invalid JSON is ignored.

inputs.name: rpcRequest.state
inputs.description: Pending-request map and sender used for the new request.

inputs.name: rpcRequest.frame
inputs.type: { id: number; method: string; params: unknown }
inputs.description: Request ID, method and parameters to send.

inputs.name: rpcRequest.timeoutMs
inputs.description: Milliseconds before the pending request is rejected as timed out.

outputs.name: rpcMessages
outputs.description: Settles matching requests, dispatches notifications or rejects incoming interactive requests as unavailable; returns nothing.

outputs.name: rpcRequest
outputs.description: Reply result, or rejection from the remote error, send failure or timeout.
